Largely inspired by Uniswap's https://github.com/Uniswap/merkle-distributor/blob/master/contracts/MerkleDistributor.sol[merkle-distributor]. BitMaps pack 256 booleans across each bit of a single 256-bit slot of `uint256` type. Hence booleans corresponding to 256 _sequential_ indices would only consume a single slot, unlike the regular `bool` which would consume an entire slot for a single value.
